summary: Iteration 3 — validated Shiprocket integration gating. Backend: 51/51 pytest passing. Added TestShiprocketGated class (6 new tests) covering: (1) GET /api/shipping/serviceability?delivery_postcode=110002 returns {enabled:false} when Shiprocket is disabled; (2) GET /api/settings never includes 'shiprocket_api_password' and always exposes boolean 'shiprocket_configured'; (3) POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/ship requires auth (401) and admin role (403); (4) When Shiprocket is disabled, /api/admin/orders/{id}/ship returns 503 with detail 'Shiprocket is not configured. Add credentials in Admin → Settings.'; (5) PUT /api/settings with enabled+email+password+pickup → subsequent GET hides password, flips shiprocket_configured to true, exposes email/enabled; (6) subsequent PUT WITHOUT password does NOT wipe the stored password (shiprocket_configured still true). Teardown resets all shiprocket_* fields back to blank/false (verified post-run: shiprocket_configured=false, shiprocket_enabled=false, no password field present). Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): /admin/settings shows 'Shipping — Shiprocket' card with all five fields (set-shiprocket_enabled toggle, set-shiprocket_api_email, set-shiprocket_password [type=password], set-shiprocket_pickup_location, set-shiprocket_pickup_postcode). /admin/orders → clicking an order row opens detail dialog with [data-testid=ship-order] 'Ship with Shiprocket' button; clicking it while disabled triggers a visible error toast exactly matching the backend detail ('Shiprocket is not configured. Add credentials in Admin → Settings.') and the network tab shows 503. Product page /products/premium-nethili-shutki: pincode checker calls /api/shipping/serviceability?delivery_postcode=110002&weight=0.5 and falls back gracefully to '✓ Delivery available to 110002. Estimated 3–6 days.' when Shiprocket is disabled. Regression PASSED end-to-end: added Nethili Shutki to cart, applied FIRST10 (saved ₹29.9), proceeded to checkout, filled address (chk-* / checkout-* testids), selected COD, Place Order → redirected to /order-confirmation/TS261006EDBC5 showing full 7-step order-timeline. Admin login works; /admin dashboard analytics (Revenue / Total Orders / AOV) render. Recipes list still renders 6 recipe-cards.

minor.issue: Response body of the PUT itself still contains 'shiprocket_api_password' (the GET redaction is applied only on GET /api/settings). Low risk since only an authenticated admin receives it right after setting it, but for defense-in-depth consider redacting on PUT too.

action_items: (LOW, optional) Redact shiprocket_api_password from PUT /api/settings response as well — mirror GET /api/settings redaction — defense in depth.
(carry-over) Previous iteration low-pri notes still open: on recipe cards without image; auto-suffixed slug UX hint; CORS allow_credentials=true with allow_origins=['*'].
critical_code_review_comments: sr_token caches globally in process memory ({_sr_token} dict) — if the admin changes credentials in Settings while a cached token exists, the old token is still used until it 401s (code already retries once on 401, so acceptable, but worth a short comment).

sr_request raises HTTPException(502) with raw Shiprocket text (truncated to 300 chars). Fine for admin, but ensure it isn't surfaced to end users via /api/shipping/serviceability — currently it is: a public caller could trigger a 502 with upstream error text if admin saved broken creds. Consider catching and returning {enabled:true, couriers:[], message:'temporarily unavailable'} instead.
server.py has grown past 1300 lines; still recommend extracting routers (auth / products / orders / recipes / shiprocket / admin / settings).
GET /api/orders/{id} remains public (no auth) — anyone with an order id can view full address and items. Flagged in iter 1 — still open.
